Label: Alarms
Description: The Alarms module as a widget: standing or archived alarms of a machine (or of the whole atelier, or of any datapoint filter) over the dashboard time range, with counters, priority ranges, search, sort, paging and acknowledge.

Settings.AtelierHint: Pick the atelier (a MachineFleet3D_Config datapoint, element .json). The widget then lists its machines; each machine's bound datapoints become the alarm scope, like the fleet's machine dashboard.
Settings.MachineIdHint: Id of the machine shown when the widget opens. Empty = the whole atelier. The machine ids are those of the atelier configuration (e.g. four-600).
Settings.LockMachineHint: Hide the machine list in the widget: the preselected machine is final.
Settings.DpFilterHint: Additional datapoints whose alarms are shown (a datapoint covers all its elements). Combine with the atelier or use alone.
Settings.StrictScopeHint: When nothing is scoped, show nothing rather than every alarm of the plant.
